# ARCHITECTURE.md — System Architecture
<!-- Generated by gsd-map-codebase sequential mapping -->

## Pattern

**Event-driven producer-consumer with polling**, running as two co-equal subsystems:

1. **Acquisition subsystem** (`34970A_5.py`) — polls instrument via GPIB, writes XML
2. **Visualization subsystem** (`streamingLab/`) — reads XML, pushes to browser via Bokeh

No shared in-memory state between the two subsystems — XML files are the **integration medium**.

## Component Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     runMain.bat                         │
│   (Orchestrator — opens 3 separate CMD windows)         │
└────────┬────────────────────┬──────────────┬────────────┘
         │                    │              │
         ▼                    ▼              ▼
┌─────────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐
│  34970A_5.py    │  │ bokeh serve  │  │VarAmbseries.py  │
│  (Logger)       │  │ streamingLab │  │  (Analysis GUI) │
│                 │  │  --port 502  │  │                 │
│  GPIB → XML     │  │  XML → Web   │  │  XML → Tkinter  │
└────────┬────────┘  └──────┬───────┘  └────────┬────────┘
         │                  │                    │
         ▼                  │                    │
  ./varamblog/              │                    │
  {YYDDD}/                  │                    │
  log_*.xml ◄───────────────┴────────────────────┘
  (Shared data store)
```

## Acquisition Subsystem — `34970A_5.py`

### Layers

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Main loop  (while True)            │
│  - ensure_xml_file() per iteration  │
│  - write INIT, wait 30 s, read avg  │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Retry block (10 attempts)          │
│  - pyvisa write + sleep + read      │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  XML persistence                    │
│  - update_xml_from_dict()           │
│  - ET.ElementTree.write()           │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Calibration / math layer           │
│  - sympy linear solve (startup)     │
│  - safe_parse_scientific()          │
│  - decode_to_dict()                 │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  VISA hardware layer                │
│  - pyvisa ResourceManager           │
│  - GPIB0::5::INSTR                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Data Flow (Acquisition)

```
34970A HW
  └─► GPIB (NI-VISA)
        └─► pyvisa.read()  → raw SCPI string (CSV with timestamps)
              └─► decode_to_dict() → {RHA, TCA, RHB, TCB} Python dict
                    └─► update_xml_from_dict() → appends <measure> to XML
                          └─► ET.write() → ./varamblog/{YYDDD}/log_*.xml
```

## Visualization Subsystem — `streamingLab/`

### Component Responsibilities

| Module | Responsibility |
|--------|---------------|
| `main.py` | Entry point — wires Visual ↔ Sensor thread, fires `main()` |
| `SensorV2.py` — `Sensor(Thread)` | Background thread: reads XML every 30 s, computes GUM uncertainty, calls `callbackFunc.update()` |
| `TestcodeLogging34970A_v2.py` — `Datalog` | XML reader: finds latest day folder → latest file → parses last `<measure>` |
| `Visual.py` — `Visual` | Bokeh document: defines real-time plot, `ColumnDataSource.stream()`, checkbox controls |
| `Visual_with_stats.py` — `VisualWithStats` | Wraps `Visual` in Tab 1; adds `VisualStats` (hourly stats) in Tab 2 |
| `Logging34970A.py` — `Datalog` | Earlier version of `Datalog` (uses `pandas.read_xml`, CSV export) — legacy |

### Threading Model

```
Main thread (Bokeh IOLoop)
  │
  ├── Sensor thread (SensorV2.Sensor)
  │     - sleeps 30 s between reads
  │     - doc.add_next_tick_callback(partial(update, ...))
  │
  └── VisualStats periodic callback (every 60 s)
        - runs on IOLoop, not separate thread
```

### Data Flow (Visualization)

```
./varamblog/{YYDDD}/log_*.xml
  └─► Datalog.list_file() → (rha, tca, rhb, tcb, timestamp)
        └─► Sensor.run()  → computes u_c, U (GUM uncertainty)
              └─► partial(Visual.update, tempa, ..., err_*)
                    └─► Bokeh tick callback
                          └─► ColumnDataSource.stream() → browser WebSocket
```

## Historical Analysis Tool — `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py`

Standalone Tkinter app (separate process). No connection to Bokeh subsystem.

```
Tkinter GUI
  ├── Browse button → select base_dir
  ├── Date/time inputs → filter period (min 3 h)
  ├── Process button
  │     ├─► list_subdirs_dates() → filter day folders by date
  │     ├─► detect_sensors() → auto-detect sensor letters from XML
  │     ├─► Sensor selection popup (Toplevel)
  │     ├─► parse_files() → pandas DataFrame
  │     ├─► Statistics computation + export to .txt
  │     └─► plot_data() → matplotlib figures
  └── Close button
```

## Key Abstractions

| Abstraction | Purpose | Risk |
|-------------|---------|------|
| `dictprop` dict | Maps sensor tags to channel+calibration | Hardcoded; adding sensor requires code change |
| `ensure_xml_file()` | Day-rollover logic | Global state `current_xmlpath` — not thread-safe |
| `Datalog.list_file()` | Latest XML reader | Retry loop (50 × 10 s = 8 min max) is excessive |
| `ColumnDataSource.stream()` | Bokeh live update | `rollover=100` limits visible history |

## Entry Points

| Entry Point | How to Launch |
|-------------|--------------|
| Full system | `runMain.bat` |
| Sensor logger only | `runVarAmb.bat` (or `python 34970A_5.py`) |
| Bokeh dashboard only | `runVarAmb2.bat` (or `bokeh serve --show streamingLab --port 502`) |
| Historical analysis | `runVarAmbSeries.bat` (or `python VarAmbseries0.6.2.py`) |
